text_block_list.text: (Dadada...!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Approaching the 4th corner, which 
Umamusume will make the first move?!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Haa, haa...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"You can do it, you can do it! Go... 
Machan!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Go! Machaaan!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
(So many camera lenses are dancing. 
Showering down on Chan-Me.)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
(Then I'll carve it out right here...! Me, 
Chan-Mi, deeply, deeply—!)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I did itttt!!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehehehe. Applause, applause, a massive 
round of applause.

Her race at the Fantasy Stakes was 
breathtaking. Everyone leaned forward to 
watch her, and it felt as though most in 
the crowd became utterly captivated.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. This won't fade away 
for a while now.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Splendid, absolutely splendid.

Aston Machan turns on her heel 
triumphantly. However—
Suddenly tripped and fell.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...I wondered why they were wandering 
aimlessly during the race. So it was your 
doing after all."

"As she looked down at her feet, I 
followed her gaze to find... her shoe was 
broken."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Looks like the soles reached their limit. 
Well, not that it mattered for Chan's 
running.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Eh, isn't Chan-san amazing?

Are you telling me she pulled off that 
kind of run in such unstable shoes...?!

The stands where everyone watched her with 
bated breath. If they hear about this, the 
excitement will spread even further, and 
surely the next race will draw an even 
bigger crowd—...
—Suddenly, an idea flashes in my mind.
choice_data_list: Should I tell someone about this...?

text_block_list.text:
To put it simply, Aston Machan's immediate 
goal is to raise her name recognition.

An event legendary enough to be called an 
anecdote, this tale would surely 
contribute greatly to boosting her 
recognition.

Without fully sorting out my thoughts, I 
decided to convey it to Aston Machan 
anyway—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
A record time like that during a mock 
race... A final spurt like this, this and 
that... And a lovely little word from 
Chan-Me...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Thinking back, there are plenty of others 
too. I'm sure there'll be loads more to 
come!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I would be honored! Broadly, and deeply.

And so, after a whole night of deep 
deliberation...

A medium that can consistently reach a 
wider audience, with relatively few text 
and image limitations, and that anyone can 
easily read—

And so, she ended up launching 'Aston 
Machan's 4-Panel Blog'.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for setting this up! Can Machan 
pitch some ideas too?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yay. In that case, I'd like this one for 
the first 4-koma.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Beginning. Chan-Mar shows off a 
razor-sharp run at the Fantasy Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Acknowledged. Moved by such sheer 
magnificence, thunderous applause erupts. 
Bravo, Ma-chan!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Twist! And to top it off, she was actually 
running with a broken shoe?! This... she 
might be a genius!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Conclusion. Run, Machan, run! Fly, Machan, 
fly! Next up is the Hanshin Juvenile 
Fillies!

"She casually decided on our next race at 
the very end, but... it's a perfect prep 
race for the Tiara route. There shouldn't 
be any problem."

—The next race was the 'Hanshin JF'. With 
the newly launched 4-panel manga in hand, 
days of even more intense training had 
begun!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"—*pant*, *gasp*, *wheeze*...! *pant*, 
*gasp*............"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Marchan's incredible, and Scarlet's 
been getting better and better too.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Still... none of that matters!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Kh, it's mine... It's mine, it's MINE...!! 
RAAAAUUUGH!!
